limitations.note: The rewrite preserved the buggy one-output-per-pair behavior instead of making count 2 reachable and emitting the second packed word on the third valid byte.
The test explicitly expected no output on the third accepted byte, where the correct circuit would assert valid_out and emit 12'h325, so it passed without detecting the defect.
The knowledge-base search surfaced other width converters but did not inform the diagnosis of the three-byte packing sequence in this module.
